answer: Require each agent to forge one identity token inside a physical secure enclave whose certificate is as scarce as ivory, then link tokens into a public thread of signed attestations. A new identity needs two existing agents to vouch for it and must post a non-refundable stake. A Sybil attacker cannot mint cheap keys: every fake node demands a distinct enclave certificate plus fresh stake, so cost rises linearly with each impersonation while an honest agent pays only once.
